# Product Categories

Manage product categories in Teamleader Focus.

```php
Teamleader::productCategories()
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Class | `McoreServices\TeamleaderSDK\Resources\Products\Categories` |
| Create / update / delete | — / — / — |
| Pagination | No |

## Endpoints

- `productCategories.list`

## Filters

Passed as the first argument to `list()`. Any other key throws.

| Filter | Description |
|---|---|
| `department_id` | The ID of the department to filter on (UUID format) |

## Methods

### `list()`

```php
list(array $filters = [], array $options = []): array
```

List product categories with filtering

- `$filters` — Filters to apply
- `$options` — Additional options (not used for this endpoint)

### `forDepartment()`

```php
forDepartment(string $departmentId): array
```

Get product categories for a specific department

- `$departmentId` — Department UUID

### `getResponseStructure()`

```php
getResponseStructure(): array
```

Get response structure documentation

### `getAvailableFilters()`

```php
getAvailableFilters(): array
```

Get available filters for product categories

## Examples

Get all product categories:

```php
$categories = Teamleader::productCategories()->list();
```

Get product categories for specific department:

```php
$categories = Teamleader::productCategories()->forDepartment("080aac72-ff1a-4627-bfe3-146b6eee979c");
```

Get categories with custom filtering:

```php
$categories = Teamleader::productCategories()->list([
                "department_id" => "department-uuid-here"
            ]);
```
